objects.name: Vey
objects.title: Wounded Standard-Bearer
objects.dialogue: Nearly... there. Sorry, I’d stand, but I’d regret it. Vey. The fire’s for anyone.
objects.revisitDialogue: Back again. Sit, if you like. I won’t ask where you’ve been.

objects.secretCue: A sword-shaped notch cuts through the old vigil mark.

objects.name: Olan
objects.title: Road Keeper
objects.dialogue: Twenty to four. Every blessed day. ...You came from the west? There’s nothing west but the old camp. Patrols turn at the post. Mind them.
objects.revisitDialogue: You got past the patrols? Hm. Most turn round at the first post.
objects.musterDialogue: Soldiers at every post, and I never heard them march in. Did you?

obstacles.text: The road begins at the sealed western breach. Its distance marks are still readable.
obstacles.title: OLD SURVEY MARK
MILEKEEPER’S RESERVE
obstacles.description: The old repair stamp still fits your palm. Two road gaps in the Hollow Mile have been bridged; the patrols keep their own route.

rooms.name: POISONED VERGE
rooms.line: Canvas sags over an abandoned road.

rooms.name: CAMP ECHO
rooms.line: The watch still walks its old rounds.

rooms.name: WATCHER’S CUT
rooms.line: A broken lookout shades the road.

rooms.name: BROKEN MUSTER
rooms.line: There is room beneath the canvas.

rooms.name: MOTHLIGHT DESCENT
rooms.line: The roots close over the last lantern.

objects.name: Orra
objects.title: Clock Keeper
objects.dialogue: Stopped. Again. Oh, hello. Orra. I’d tell you the time if I had it. If you’re going deeper, look at a branch before you trust it. Some of them aren’t there.
objects.revisitDialogue: Still stopped. I’ve been told never to shake it, so I’ve stopped shaking it. The path back’s clear.
objects.musterDialogue: Bells started while you were off. Nobody I know is ringing them. If the low road’s crowded, there’s the workers’ reserve above the far end of Briar Run. My daughter used to fetch wraps from it. Let it go and a walkway drops through the canopy.

objects.name: Pell
objects.title: Resin Worker
objects.dialogue: You’re not resin crew. Here’s the trick, then. Amber on the windward side of a branch, it’s real. Amber on the lee side, don’t jump. You’ll go straight through.
objects.revisitDialogue: Worked it out, did you? Took me a nettle patch.

objects.name: Hale
objects.title: Quiet Veteran
objects.dialogue: Another one for the sword? Roots have it. Vine runs to a counterweight. Hang off that, not the hilt.
objects.revisitDialogue: Another one for the sword? Roots have it. Vine runs to a counterweight. Hang off that, not the hilt.
objects.armedDialogue: Where’d you learn to hold it like that? I’ll sit a while. Shoulder’s not finished complaining.

objects.secretCue: One old root seam is bruised as if it remembers speed.

objects.text: OR JUST FLY OVER THE LEVER
THE WOODS HAVE A ROOF. IT LIES TOO.

obstacles.title: BIRCH-CUT OATH
RESINWORKERS’ RESERVE
obstacles.description: Dry bandages smell faintly of resin. The old canopy walk has unfolded above the copied paths. Its last board meets the root crown.

armor.name: Mothsilk Mantle
armor.mantleRule: Banks Ward until one whole wound is prevented.

rooms.name: MOTHLIGHT REFUGE
rooms.line: A quiet place to listen, trade, and choose when to leave.
rooms.ambience: moths against old glass; a clock refusing to tick

rooms.name: OATHBLADE CLEARING
rooms.line: Old roots tighten around a familiar hilt.

rooms.name: BITING CANOPY
rooms.line: The roots draw breath beneath the canopy.

rooms.name: MIRROR THICKET
rooms.line: Two crowns bend into different winds.
rooms.ambience: two sets of leaves moving out of time

rooms.name: ROOTBOUND PASSAGE
rooms.line: Iron rings beyond the hollow roots.
